dogecoin.text:
Then stupid @elonmusk had to find $DOGE and start tweeting about. I watched what little #doge I had left in robinhood (bought back into it once it hit RH) sky rocket to $0.69 and cried myself to sleep that night.
Could have turned $100 to $345,000.

Lesson learned? PATIENCE. 

👇🏼

My biggest regret in #crypto? Selling the 500,000+ $DOGE I had in 2017/2018. 

I used to stake $SPRTS (sprouts coin) on #BTCpop. Sprouts staked like crazy! I would then transfer to yobit and then trade for doge. I would then trade between 20-30 sats to build doge bag.

👇🏼

Bought more $SOUL, $DOGE, and $BTC.
